en_title: The Sun That Dwells Within Us
en_excerpt: December in a foreign winter brings a sweet longing for home — and an invitation to rediscover a warmth that is born of encounter and sharing.
en_meta_description: December far from home: how longing can become a bridge, and why the light we search for outside also lives within us.
en_content:
Text: Ana Luiza A Duarte

Integrative Therapist

December arrives like a warm embrace in the middle of the cold.

While the streets light up and the world seems to deck itself out in promises, there are those who feel

a sweet longing — for home, for family, for language, for the smell of fresh coffee coming from

the kitchen. It is the heart trying to find its place even far from the place of origin.

It is natural to miss the sun that kept us company all year round. To miss the light that warmed

our skin, the full table, the familiar voices. But perhaps it is now, in the middle of this foreign

winter, that we can rediscover another kind of warmth — the one born of

encounter, of sharing, of presence.

Longing can be a bridge. It can lead us to the other, to the new community that welcomes us, to the

affinities that bring us closer. An invitation to open the doors of the house and of the heart, to

create bonds that warm us when the sun takes its time to appear.

And, as the year says goodbye, something in us also reorganises itself. The silence between one

celebration and the next invites us to look inward: what do we want to carry forward? What

shall we let bloom again from 2025?

There is always a spark that resists, even on the shortest days.

Perhaps the secret is to remember that the light we seek so much on the outside also lives

within us.

That the warmth of the summer left behind can be rekindled in the smile of a new friend,

in a gesture of care, in a moment of gratitude.

So, this December, light your own sun.

Gather. Share. Celebrate — even from a distance.

Because, when we meet one another, home happens again — wherever we are.

Ana Luiza A Duarte

Integrative Therapist
